note: The National Credit Regulations, regulation 17, as Acts Online publishes it: a consumer's payment profile may be displayed five years; an adverse classification one year, a further listing the game doesn't model. Read in Acts Online's copy, registered as secondary. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.
